modmenu.summaryTranslation.opensoundboar: Play MP3s through Simple Voice Chat, Plasmo Voice, or just locally.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.opensound:
A soundboard for Simple Voice Chat and Plasmo Voice. Both are optional: without a voice chat, sounds simply play for you.

Play MP3 files to everyone around you, organize them in folders, set per-sound volumes and start points, bind sounds to keys or a radial sound wheel, and search or download new sounds from YouTube without leaving the game.

Press U in-game to open the soundboard.
